issues.display_title: Issue #4411: feat(upload): handle RAG client actions for Google Drive, Dropbox, and Auto Stitching
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Support executing RAG Copilot client actions for Google Drive, Dropbox, and Auto Stitching in gothru-dashboard (paired with GoThruMedia/gothru-rag#60). When triggered from the chat copilot, the dashboard should switch to the requested upload tab, invoke the integration picker/dropzone, and record Countly analytics telemetry.

Proposed Changes

  • Component Imperative Handles:
    • src/components/organism/UploadPanoramas/GoogleDriveV2.jsx: implement useImperativeHandle exposing openGoogleDrivePicker().
    • src/components/organism/UploadPanoramas/DropboxChooser.jsx: wrap in forwardRef and expose openDropboxChooser().
    • src/pages/Tour/Detail/Upload/Components/UploadStitch.jsx: utilize existing triggerFileInput().
  • Event Handling (src/pages/Tour/Detail/Upload/Upload.jsx):
    • Attach listener for window event gothru:action.
    • On trigger_gdrive_picker / target google_drive: switch activeTab to google_drive and invoke openGoogleDrivePicker().
    • On trigger_dropbox_chooser / target dropbox: switch activeTab to dropbox and invoke openDropboxChooser().
    • On trigger_stitching_picker / target stitching: switch activeTab to stitching and invoke triggerFileInput().
    • Emit Countly rag_client_action_executed with status: "success" on execution.
  • Analytics Mapping (src/utils/countly.js):
    • Add to ALLOWED_SEGMENTATIONS.action:
      • trigger_gdrive_picker
      • trigger_dropbox_chooser
      • trigger_stitching_picker
      • navigate_upload_google_drive
      • navigate_upload_dropbox
      • navigate_upload_stitching
    • Update resolveCompositeAction to map targets containing ?page=google_drive, ?page=dropbox, and ?page=stitching.
  • Tests:
    • Add unit tests in src/utils/countly.test.js validating composite action resolution.
    • Test event listener handling in Layout.countly.test.jsx / Upload.test.jsx.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Dispatched gothru:action events for Google Drive, Dropbox, and Auto Stitching switch the active tab and open the corresponding picker dialog.
  • Countly telemetry records rag_client_action_executed with correct action names.
  • All tests pass via npm test -- --watchAll=false src/utils/countly.test.js src/components/layouts/Layout.countly.test.jsx.

issues.display_title: Issue #4412: [Copilot] Support Clone & Unarchive Global Modals with Google Button Condition Gating and Countly Tracking
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Support global host modals for clone_tour and unarchive_tour client actions, integrate Countly telemetry, and gate unarchive actions against DOM/state availability.

Scope & Requirements

  1. Global Modal Integration:

    • Register clone_tour and unarchive_tour in TOUR_TOOL_TARGETS (src/components/layouts/Layout.jsx).
    • Render CloneTour and CheckUnarchiveGoogle inside GlobalTourActionModal.jsx.
    • Guard CheckUnarchiveGoogle against tours with archived === false.

  2. Countly Telemetry:

    • Add open_modal_clone and open_modal_unarchive to permitted action enums in src/utils/countly.js.
    • Map composite actions ('open_modal', 'clone_tour') -> 'open_modal_clone' and ('open_modal', 'unarchive_tour') -> 'open_modal_unarchive'.

  3. Condition Gating & State Scoping:

    • Add data-action="unarchive-google" to the Google unarchive button in TourTools.jsx.
    • Expose has_unarchive_button and tour archived status in window.__GOTHRU_PAGE_STATE__.
    • In useChatAi.js, only attach has_unarchive_button to pageContext when rawPageState.tour_id exists (preventing false negatives on global routes like /my-tours or /storage).
    • Suppress (undefined) clientAction for unarchive_tour if [data-action="unarchive-google"] is missing in the DOM or if the tour is not archived.

Acceptance Criteria

  • gothru:action event for clone_tour opens CloneTour modal and records open_modal_clone.
  • gothru:action event for unarchive_tour opens CheckUnarchiveGoogle modal and records open_modal_unarchive.
  • has_unarchive_button is omitted from pageContext on non-tour detail routes.
  • Unarchive modal card and auto-trigger are completely suppressed when the Google unarchive button is absent.
  • All frontend unit tests pass (npm test).

issues.display_title: Issue #4413: [Copilot] Support Merge Tour Global Modal, Slash Command, and Persistent Action Button UX
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Add global host modal support for merge_tour, register the /merge slash command, integrate Countly telemetry, and ensure client action buttons remain visible in chat bubbles when modals are auto-triggered.

Scope & Requirements

  1. Global Tour Action Modal Dispatch:

    • Register merge_tour in TOUR_TOOL_TARGETS in src/components/layouts/Layout.jsx.
    • Render MergeTour component inside GlobalTourActionModal.jsx with active tour data.

  2. Slash Command Registration:

    • Add /merge command definition ("Merge Tour") to src/components/layouts/ChatAiSidebar/constants/slashCommands.js.

  3. Countly Telemetry:

    • Add open_modal_merge to permitted action enums in src/utils/countly.js.
    • Map composite action ('open_modal', 'merge_tour') -> 'open_modal_merge'.

  4. Persistent Action Button UX:

    • In ClientActionCard.jsx, remove action.auto_trigger render suppression so action buttons stay visible in chat bubbles even when auto-opened.
    • Allows users to re-open the modal at any time if they accidentally close it or dismiss the backdrop.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Dispatching gothru:action with target merge_tour opens MergeTour modal.
  • Countly logs open_modal_merge for merge tour actions.
  • Slash command /merge appears in autocomplete dropdown.
  • Auto-triggered action buttons remain visible and clickable in assistant chat bubbles.
  • All frontend unit tests pass (npm test).

issues.display_title: Issue #4414: [Copilot] Support Split Tour Global Modal, Slash Command, and Countly Telemetry
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Add global host modal support for split_tour, register the /split slash command, expose active tour metadata (tour_type, total_panorama) to global page state, and integrate Countly telemetry.

Scope & Requirements

  1. Expose Page State to Global Copilot Context:

    • Include tour_type and total_panorama in window.__GOTHRU_PAGE_STATE__ within src/components/layouts/Layout.jsx.

  2. Global Tour Action Modal Dispatch:

    • Register split_tour in TOUR_TOOL_TARGETS in src/components/layouts/Layout.jsx.
    • Render SplitTour component inside GlobalTourActionModal.jsx with active tour data, passing totalPanorama.
    • Handle success callback and emit gothru:tour_updated with action: 'split_tour'.

  3. Slash Command Registration:

    • Add /split command definition ("Split Tour") to src/components/layouts/ChatAiSidebar/constants/slashCommands.js.

  4. Countly Telemetry:

    • Add open_modal_split to permitted action enums in src/utils/countly.js.
    • Map composite action ('open_modal', 'split_tour') -> 'open_modal_split'.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Dispatching gothru:action with target split_tour opens SplitTour modal.
  • Active tour type and panorama count are passed to SplitTour.
  • Countly logs open_modal_split for split tour actions.
  • Slash command /split appears in autocomplete dropdown.
  • All frontend unit tests pass (npm test).

Result

  • Exposed total_panorama and tour_type in window.__GOTHRU_PAGE_STATE__ within src/components/layouts/Layout.jsx.
  • Registered split_tour in TOUR_TOOL_TARGETS and rendered SplitTour in GlobalTourActionModal.jsx with dashboard gating guards.
  • Added /split slash command ("Split Tour") to Ask AI autocomplete.
  • Mapped composite action to open_modal_split in Countly telemetry.
  • Verified test suite: 138 unit tests passed across 9 test suites (100%).
